repository_checks.conclusion: The PSG-Audio dataset is used for EEG C3/C4, EOG, chin EMG and pressure-cannula channels at100Hz, not microphone PCM.
Literal actigraphy thresholds plus context rules and fixed confidence values, not a pretrained acoustic-stage model.
Metrics calculated from already-scored epoch labels, not waveform-to-stage inference.

strongest_audio_lead.name: SleepFormer / Sound-Based Sleep Staging by Exploiting Real-World Unlabeled Data
strongest_audio_lead.prerequisite: Publicly redistributable fitted audio-to-stage weights including the task head and exact frontend/normalization/window/output-edge contract; the inspected SDK is restricted and API-key based, not an authorized open offline model release.
strongest_audio_lead.limits: Paper existence and reported home/PSG-Audio evaluation do not establish a public checkpoint. Full participant-split IDs and exact inference preprocessing were not established here. No API request, account creation, SDK binary download or decompile performed.

network_accounting: Connector/search text transfer has no measured wire-byte accounting. Only metadata/code was read; this pass downloaded no model, audio or dataset files. It does not amend prior study ledgers.
